changes: Added sharing: publish boards, categories and snippets to any number of named public pages, each with its own URL and no login required to view.
Added a language switcher in Account settings (German/English) — previously the app was translated but had no way to actually switch.

Redesigned the Bookmarks page: boards now switch without a page reload, categories support drag-and-drop reordering, links have up/down move controls as a non-drag alternative, and board/category management (rename, delete, reorder) is consolidated into one modal.

Redesigned the dashboard: pinned boards, categories and links now share one grid with consistent ordering, added an optional greeting header with date/time and current weather (via Open-Meteo, no API key required), and fixed an ordering bug where newly pinned items could land in the wrong position.

Redesigned the Snippets page and detail view: proper sort-by dropdown (created/updated/name, each with direction toggle), real syntax highlighting, a raw-code copy URL, and a two-column detail layout.
Fixed automatic favicon detection to look up each site's own declared icon instead of just guessing /favicon.ico.
Added Docker packaging: Dockerfile, docker-compose, a GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the image, and an Unraid template.
Reorganized Settings into more focused tabs (Interface, Weather, Backups split out from Account, App/update check).
Initial release of BookmarkRanger — self-hosted bookmarks and code snippet manager.
